description: This file is a shell script containing tests for a git notes fanout restructuring mechanism, including functions to verify fanout structure and a series of test cases that create, verify, and modify notes in a git repository.

methods.name: path_has_fanout
methods.description: Checks if a given path has the specified fanout based on its directory structure.

methods.name: touched_one_note_with_fanout
methods.description: Determines if a note was added or removed and whether it has the specified fanout.

methods.name: all_notes_have_fanout
methods.description: Verifies that all notes in a given revision have the specified fanout.
